items.title: Deliver petabytes of Apache Kafka data to Amazon S3 at up to 60% lower cost with Amazon MSK Express brokers
items.summary: Amazon MSK Express brokers now deliver Apache Kafka topic data to Amazon S3 at up to 60% lower cost, with no Kafka Connect to run. You create a channel on a topic and pay only for the data delivered. In this post, we cover the two challenges of delivering Kafka data to Amazon S3 today and how Express brokers and data delivery to Amazon S3 address each one.
items.creator: Diksha Dubey
categories: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)

items.title: Migrate Apache Solr to Amazon OpenSearch Service with the AI-driven Migration Assistant
items.summary: Migrate a 600,000-document Apache Solr catalog to Amazon OpenSearch Serverless end to end using the AI-driven agent mode in the Migration Assistant for Amazon OpenSearch Service, from assessment through validated backfill.
items.creator: Michael Torio

items.title: Analyze Anthropic usage, spend, and access with AWS Glue, Amazon S3 Tables, and AWS Quick
items.summary: The new AWS Glue connector for Anthropic reads Claude usage, cost, and API key data into AWS without custom code. This post shows how to land it in Amazon S3 Tables as Apache Iceberg tables, join it with your business data, query it with Amazon Athena, and visualize AI spend and governance in AWS Quick.
items.creator: Daniyal Alam
